message: 終わりの来ない夜

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew! I'm totally beat!」

name: Synn
message: 「I think we've done everything we possibly could...」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if there's anything we overlooked?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's fine. Everything's all set.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All that's left is to wait for the big day tomorrow, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「For now--」

name: Everyone
message: 「Great work today!」
Several weeks had already passed since the project kicked off.

name: Synn
message: 「It went by in the blink of an eye~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you acting like it's already over? The real show is tomorrow, tomorrow!」

name: Ria
message: 「We need to get to bed early tonight and rest up for tomorrow.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My heart is pounding so much I'm worried I won't be able to sleep tonight.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's not like it's the night before a school field trip.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you couldn't sleep back then, Misa? You've got a pretty cute side after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even I went through a phase like that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「We've been running all over the place, so our bodies are tired. Once you lie down, you'll fall right asleep. Right, Lolotte?」
Guess there's no need to worry after all.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tomorrow's gonna go great, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「It has to. After all, this is our debut.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! Besides, it's totally fine if we mess up a little on our first try!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't jinx us like that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's a festival, so let's keep things light and just have fun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. You're right.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even after tomorrow is over, the Holy Night Festival is up next, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Things are gonna get busy again, huh~. I bet there'll be tons of awesome stuff in proportion to how busy we get!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, getting all fired up now, aren't we!」

name: Synn
message: 「Crusaders activities are going smoothly too, so I wonder if we might get a mid-term bonus or something soon?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If that's what you want, you've already gotten plenty of it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Being surrounded by tons of girls.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Getting to eat delicious food.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And getting to walk home shoulder-to-shoulder with cute little Nanaka-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the same as always.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nyahahaha.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, don't call yourself cute.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that Re-Crea issue Helena-san mentioned. Looks like it'll pass without anything happening, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope so......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shooting stars go zoom~ zoom~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「With this many falling, no matter how many wishes I had, it wouldn't be enough.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Having just one wish come true is more than enough.」
Even so, the number of falling stars really is increasing day by day.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then. Guess I'll take a nice hot bath and hit the sack.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah--!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you yelling for, you're gonna disturb the neighbors.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh no, we don't have enough staff passes, so I still had to make a few more. Ahh~~ I feel like I'm forgetting something else, too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geez, you're hopeless! I'll help you out too.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, you've gotta get to bed soon.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't hold back! Oh, I know. Since we're at it, let's call everyone over too.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, you don't have to go that far!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Actually, I still have stuff left to do myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't brag about it! Besides, won't it bother them...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. I already called them.」

name: Synn
message: 「That was fast.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, there's something I'm a little unsure about regarding the attendee list.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, that worked out great.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm in no position to talk, so forget it.」

name: Ria
message: 「When you're in a bind, leave it to your upperclassman~」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehe... You'll owe me big for this.」

name: Ria
message: 「By the way, is the timetable for the volunteers done yet?」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah!! That was my job, I'm so sorry!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm beyond worried about whether tomorrow's gonna go off without a hitch.」
And so--
